description: Use when you need a transaction by hash on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon or Optimism: from, to, value, nonce, gas and fee fields, block, confirmations, method id and input (first 1 KB). Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /evm/tx, $0.002 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge.
name: evm_transaction
title: EVM transaction
